entities.name: Skola Vale
entities.description: An enchanted chaparral valley on Theros blessed by Nylea, ancestral home of the satyrs and a place of carefree revelry.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane on which Skola Vale lies, in its northeast.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: The god patron of Skola Vale who, according to myth, poured her wineskin over it and turned goats into the first satyrs.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: A god also said to hold sway in Skola Vale.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A god whose followers, the Firedancers, live in the Katachthons.

entities.name: Satyr
entities.description: The only race native to Skola Vale, hedonistic and anarchic, born from goats that drank Nylea's wine.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A polis that shares a border with Skola Vale.

entities.name: Sperche River
entities.description: A river west of Skola Vale.

entities.name: Katachthon Mountains
entities.description: Mountains across the Sperche River from Skola Vale; home of the Firedancers.

entities.name: Nessian Wood
entities.description: A forest across the Sperche River from Skola Vale.

entities.name: Oreskos
entities.description: A place across the Sperche River from Skola Vale.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A polis home to the Anapsian school of philosophy.

entities.name: Bakkeia
entities.description: Violent satyr celebrations held in caves involving induced madness and ritual sacrifice, not widely practiced for ages.

entities.name: Rollick Nights
entities.description: The most common and archetypal kind of satyr revel.

entities.name: Cult of Horns
entities.description: A satyr group that holds secret revels, rumored to lure humans into servitude and sacrifice.

entities.name: Dawngreets
entities.description: Satyrs who explore Theros and serve as emissaries.

entities.name: Firedancers
entities.description: Satyr followers of Purphoros who served as hoplites for Anax after he became a demigod.

entities.name: Nylea's Favored
entities.description: Satyr druids that defend Skola's borders.

entities.name: Revelers
entities.description: Satyr hedonists who live only for music and wine.

entities.name: Sibyls
entities.description: Satyr oracles who lead communities, warn of danger, select Dawngreets and decide on Cult of Horns initiation.

entities.name: Thornbreakers
entities.description: Satyr rangers whose arrows are blessed by Nylea.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: Transformed into a demigod; the Firedancers served as his hoplites.

entities.name: Cresa
entities.description: The eldest of the sibyls.

entities.name: Gallia of the Endless Dance
entities.description: A notable Skolan.

entities.name: Kexosrexsos
entities.description: A notable Skolan.

entities.name: Raissa
entities.description: A notable Skolan, mother of Xenagos.

entities.name: Thisbi
entities.description: A notable Skolan, a Dawngreet.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: God of revels and a notable Skolan; son of Raissa.

events.summary: According to myth, Nylea pours her wineskin over the valley, giving it life and turning goats into the first satyrs.
events.quote: she poured her wineskin over it, infusing the land with life and turning the goats who drank from it into the first satyrs

relations.note: By myth, goats that drank Nylea's wine became the first satyrs.
relations.quote: turning the goats who drank from it into the first satyrs

relations.note: Nylea is the patron of the valley.
relations.quote: As the patron of the valley, Nylea is the most heavily worshipped in Skola Vale
The chaparral is to the northeast of Theros, sharing a border with Setessa .
Firedancers are followers of Purphoros that live in the Katachthons.

relations.note: They served as hoplites for Anax.
relations.quote: They served as hoplites for Anax after he was transformed into a demigod .
Sibyls are oracles that lead satyr communities, the eldest of which is Cresa.
